OrganizationGrantSync._comment: XD01-290 — CoreApiBaseUrl must point at the SAME Core GeoAssets Server as GeoCoreServer:BaseUrl above, just the /api/identity prefix instead of /api/geoassets. PollInterval is the real upper bound on how stale a locally-mirrored grant can be relative to the real OrganizationGrants table — see OrganizationGrantSyncOptions. XD01-328: the same section drives the scoped role assignment sync (/scoped-role-assignments/sync, needs users:read), so PollInterval also bounds how long a role revoked on another organization still counts here.

Postgres._comment: StatementTimeoutMs is unset by default (XD01-214) — set it to cap how long any single statement on the FieldService connection string may run (this host's own database since XD01-386; it no longer opens the core GeoAssets database), a server-side 'noisy neighbor' backstop for the shared tier.
